messages:
alex: Noticing a sudden rise in GPU pod evictions in ap-southeast1 over the last 40m. Eviction count ~2.2x baseline. Root seems like attach timeouts + heavy fragmentation.

riya: Confirmed. device_attach_duration_ms p95 jumped to 17s. Several nodes show nf_conntrack_count ~127k of 131072.

derek: Impacted workload = fractional GPU tiny-gang with requiredDuringScheduling nodeAffinity and hard podAntiAffinity. Because they can't share, scheduler keeps preempting to free entire nodes.

alex: Short-term plays: 1) conntrack canary to bump nf_conntrack_max on 10% of nodes, 2) temporary softening of anti-affinity for tiny-gang, 3) scale warm-pool by +1 node as fallback.

riya: I'll roll a privileged daemonset canary to run `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` on 8 nodes (10%). Watch conntrack_drops and attach_latency.

derek: I'll push a scheduler hook that treats annotation `redwood.io/allow-soft-pack=true` as a soft anti-affinity override for 30m. Canary on non-critical tiny-gang jobs.

oncall: infra-bot created INC-2026-401: "ap-southeast1 attach latency -> eviction churn" assigned to eng-platform. If canary doesn't calm preempts in 15m, ops will provision one on-demand GPU node in region for 8h.

alex: Longer-term: scheduler should expose a binpack bias flag for fractional requests + a labeled warm set for tiny-gang so packets prefer compaction and reduce whole-node reclamations. Create ticket SCHED-240.

riya: Canary rolling now to 10% — will report metrics in 5m.

derek: Noting we should also capture fragmentation ratio metric per AZ (freeSlots/totalGpuSlots) and alert when fragmentation > 0.6.

alex: Good call. Add that to alerting and to postmortem template. Keep updates in this thread. :eyes:
